sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Mazes and Keys is a simple yet challenging puzzle game. The game's mechanics are easy to learn, but difficult to master. Here's a breakdown of how the game works:

In each maze, you'll start at the entrance and your goal is to reach the colored star at the end. However, your path will be blocked by doors that can only be unlocked with the right key. To unlock the doors, you'll need to collect the corresponding keys. Sounds simple, right? Well, it's not as easy as it sounds. You'll need to think strategically and use your wits to figure out which keys to collect and when.

One of the key features of Mazes and Keys is its use of keys and doors. The game has a total of 7 keys, each with its own unique ability. For example, the red key can unlock red doors, while the blue key can unlock blue doors. The twist lies in the fact that each key can only unlock one type of door, making it essential to collect the right key at the right time.

Another important aspect of the game is the use of power-ups. Throughout the game, you'll come across power-ups that can help you progress through the maze. For example, the speed boost power-up will allow you to move faster through the maze, while the key finder power-up will highlight the location of a key. These power-ups can be a game-changer, especially in the later levels of the game.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Mazes and Keys are simple yet challenging. With its use of keys, doors, and power-ups, the game requires strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to progress through the levels.
